title: Tiptap Editor Link Rel & Target Attributes Fix
desc: Rich text editor mein links ke rel aur target attributes ka issue solve kiya: default rel clear kiya aur rel='noopener noreferrer nofollow' ko dropdown options ke sath customize kiya.

title: Side-by-Side Compact Email Template Design
desc: Email template redesign kiya: bulky boxes ko chota karke modern 2-column side-by-side layout banaya (Left: Petrol & Fuel, Right: Sarafa Gold Market).

title: Custom Action Buttons & Target URLs
desc: Admin panel mein Petrol aur Gold buttons ke labels aur redirect URLs customize karne ka option diya, jo live preview aur email template dono mein bind hain.

title: Mobile-Responsive Email Layout
desc: Responsive CSS add ki taake mobile screens par side-by-side columns squish na hon balki automatically full-width clean stacked cards mein render hon.

title: Fuel Rates Today's Date Sync Fix
desc: PSO sync logic theek kiya taake PSO ke purani announcement date (11 Sep) ke bajaye aaj ki live date (12 Sep) top par record aur display ho.

title: Nightly Rates Auto-Sync (12:15 AM PKT)
desc: Background cron worker banaya jo har raat 12:15 AM par Sarafa Gold aur PSO Petrol dono ko auto-sync karta hai taake subha se pehle fresh rates live hon.

title: Database Schema & Prisma Migrations
desc: Tamam naye models aur schedule settings ki official Prisma migrations banayein aur deploy kiya, database schema ko 100% up to date kar ke commit kiya.
